pause_selection: Same earliest theta-qualified measured pause per animal as v1, with the existing frozen cohort and original independently verified endpoint. No replacement pauses, cells or animals.
cell_selection: Same first eight frozen unit IDs and their documented LFP reference correspondence as v1. This is development, not an untouched validation bank.
generator: Exactly the v1 conditional independent-Poisson generator and per-pause random seeds. Saved native theta phases, fixed cellular preferences, pi/2 POST preference changes for even-numbered cells, and observed PRE/POST behavior, clock gaps and finite-phase masks remain unchanged. There are no neural interactions or replay-driven updates.
comparison: Compare the amended guarded training-only smooth Poisson GLM with the oracle using exact generating intensities, identical counts and physical-lag support. Any missing prediction or nonconverged fit stops the run rather than removing windows or cells. Record both the original source protocol and amended estimator identities.
summary: Same fixed 112 animal-pair development family and Bonferroni-corrected two-sided Monte Carlo t intervals as v1. Compare systematic fitted-minus-oracle discrepancies. Do not interpret these dependent pairs as biological subjects or this development test as a full-procedure false-positive calibration.
claim_boundary: A development improvement does not authorize a biological association. A separate frozen validation bank must still cover no-update, rate drift, shared theta, existing coordination, order-specific update and regression-to-mean. Replay validation, animal-level inference and the complete PF test remain unfinished.
